barbed.name: Barbed
barbed.description: Reflect 30-80% of each hit's pre-reduction damage back at your attacker.

bloodthirsty.name: Bloodthirsty
bloodthirsty.description: 10-25% chance on kill to heal 10% of your damage share.

brutal.name: Brutal
brutal.description: +5-24 melee strength from this item. Adds directly to the item's equipment bonus.

bulwark.name: Bulwark
bulwark.description: Reflect 2-5% of pre-reduction damage per 100 total defence bonus, up to 250% total.

attuned.name: Attuned
attuned.description: Pierces 10-30% of stat-based damage mitigation. Multiplies with weakness exploitation.

heavy.name: Heavy
heavy.description: +5-24 ranged strength from this item. Adds directly to the item's equipment bonus.

arcane.name: Arcane
arcane.description: +5-24 magic strength from this item. Adds directly to the item's equipment bonus.

warded.name: Warded
warded.description: +20-280 melee defence from this item. Adds directly to the item's equipment bonus.

grounded.name: Grounded
grounded.description: +20-280 magic defence from this item. Adds directly to the item's equipment bonus.

shielding.name: Shielding
shielding.description: +20-280 ranged defence from this item. Adds directly to the item's equipment bonus.

blessed.name: Blessed
blessed.description: +1-6 prayer bonus from this item. Adds directly to the item's equipment bonus.

devout.name: Devout
devout.description: 20-70% slower prayer drain while worn. Total bonus capped at 70%.

echoing.name: Echoing
echoing.description: 2-16% chance each attack in any style repeats as a full extra hit. The echo uses your live max hit; normally one echo per attack.

efficient.name: Efficient
efficient.description: Special attacks cost 10-20% less energy, rounded up, never below 1. Total bonus capped at 60%. Also raises Ravaging Ripper proc chance.

elemental.name: Elemental
elemental.description: Air, earth, fire and water spellbook spells deal 30-75% more damage. All worn bonus caps at 300%.

elusive.name: Elusive
elusive.description: 0.5-10% chance to completely avoid a hit. Misses are not rerolled; all worn dodge caps at 20%.

energising.name: Energising
energising.template: Restore {v}% more special attack energy from regeneration and potions
energising.description: Special attack refills 10-25% larger - natural pulses and potions. Energy still caps at 100.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.description: Deal 10-25% bonus damage against targets below 40% HP.

flanking.name: Flanking
flanking.description: +3-25% flanking damage from this item. Bonus damage when the target is not targeting or facing you. Caps at 50% total.

fleetfooted.name: Fleetfooted
fleetfooted.description: While walking or running, enemy attack hits deal 5-50% less damage. Always activates when moving; no proc chance. Maximum movement reduction 50%. A positive hit deals at least 1 damage. Does not reduce poison/venom ticks, direct hazards, recoil or health costs. Applies when the hit lands; queued movement or teleporting does not count.

gluttonous.name: Gluttonous
gluttonous.description: 5-45% shorter wait after each bite. Never below 1 tick.

guarded.name: Guarded
guarded.description: Subtracts 1-5 damage from every hit you take, never below 1. Applies after percentage reduction.

hordemaster.name: Hordemaster
hordemaster.description: Your summons attack 1-2 tick(s) faster, down to a 1-tick delay.

everhive.name: Everhive
everhive.description: Your greater thralls last 30-100 extra ticks before fading.

juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
juggernaut.description: Increases combat damage dealt by 0.4-1% per 100 of your highest defence bonus, up to 50% total.

lethal.name: Lethal
lethal.description: Critical strikes deal 1-10% more damage on top of the base 1.75x multiplier.

penetrating.name: Penetrating
penetrating.description: +20-50% prayer penetration from this item. Ignores that share of the target's damage reduction, including overhead prayers. Caps at 75% total.

prosperous.name: Prosperous
prosperous.description: 2-16% better drop rates while worn. All worn magic find caps at +50%.

purified.name: Purified
purified.description: Reduces poison and venom status-tick damage. Below Tier V, positive ticks deal at least 1 damage. Tier V grants full poison and venom immunity while worn and clears existing poison or venom. Protection ends when unequipped. Does not block direct attacks, poison clouds or dragonfire.

renewing.name: Renewing
renewing.description: Natural health pulses come 5-25% sooner. Total bonus capped at 75%. Cannot reach instant pulses.

restorative.name: Restorative
restorative.description: +1-7 extra HP each time your health regenerates naturally.

reverent.name: Reverent
reverent.description: Potions restore 5-100% more prayer, including renewal pulses. Rounds down to whole prayer points. Does not increase maximum prayer, preserve doses or bypass restoration restrictions.

searing.name: Searing
searing.description: 2-16% chance on hit to set the target burning: 3 hits over ~6 ticks, each up to a third of your max hit. Burn ticks cannot retrigger burn.

serrated.name: Serrated
serrated.description: 2-16% chance on hit to wound the target: 5 fixed ticks over ~10 ticks, each a tenth of your max hit. Bleed ticks cannot retrigger bleed.

telekinetic-hands.name: Telekinetic Hands
telekinetic-hands.description: Each gather cycle has a 10-60% chance to send gathered items straight to your bank. Worn tools and outfits feed the same roll.

crafty-hands.name: Crafty Hands
crafty-hands.description: Each gather cycle has a 3-25% chance to automatically process gathered items. Worn tools and outfits feed the same roll.

ordered-extra.name: Ordered Extra
ordered-extra.template: +{v}% chance for a 50-bar bonus while smithing
ordered-extra.description: While smithing, each action has a 0.75-4.5% chance to award 50 bars of the type used. Stacks with Fluxious.

pie-ous-hammer.name: Pie-ous Hammer
pie-ous-hammer.description: Each smithing action has an additional 0.5-3% chance to find an Imcando geode.

base-parts.name: Base Parts
base-parts.template: +{v}% chance to also get melt materials from smithed items
base-parts.description: Each item you smith has a {v}% chance to also give half the materials you would get from melting it down (odd cores and embers round down half the time). The smithed item is kept.

caught-pie-handed.name: Caught Pie Handed
caught-pie-handed.description: Each thieving action has an additional 1-6% chance to find an Imcando geode.

sleight-of-hand.name: Sleight of Hand
sleight-of-hand.description: Each thieving action has a 3-25% chance to double its loot. Stacks with the rogue outfit.

sticky-fingers.name: Sticky Fingers
sticky-fingers.description: Pickpocketing keeps repeating 40-400% longer before you stop, so you can stay away from the keyboard for longer.

alchemy.name: Alchemy
alchemy.template: +{v}% of Runecrafting experience gained as coins
alchemy.description: Receive coins equal to 5-50% of the Runecrafting experience you gain.

essence-efficiency.name: Essence Efficiency
essence-efficiency.description: Runecrafting yields 6-60% more runes, rounded down.

ethereal-parts.name: Ethereal Parts
ethereal-parts.template: +{v}% chance to also get melt materials from warded items
ethereal-parts.description: Each item you craft at the warding obelisk or loom has a {v}% chance to also give half the materials you would get from melting it down (odd cores and embers round down half the time). The crafted item is kept.

boner-boost.name: Boner Boost
boner-boost.template: +{v}% chance to save bones at altars
boner-boost.description: Bones offered at an altar have an additional 2-15% chance to be saved.

stuffed-more-in.name: Stuffed More In
stuffed-more-in.description: Altar offerings use 10-100% more bones at once, rounded down.

portable-sacrifice.name: Portable Sacrifice
portable-sacrifice.description: Restore 1-6 prayer points each time a bone is buried, including by a bonecrusher.

fire-stoker.name: Fire Stoker
fire-stoker.description: Firemaking burns 10-100% more logs at once, rounded down.

ash-recycler.name: Ash Recycler
ash-recycler.template: +{v}% chance to bank ashes while firemaking
ash-recycler.description: Each log you burn has a 6-50% chance to send random ashes to your bank.

rising-sea-levels.name: Rising Sea Levels
rising-sea-levels.template: +{v}% chance for a potion per log burnt
rising-sea-levels.description: Each log you burn has a 0.5-3% chance to give a random four-dose potion.

become-the-event.name: Become the Event
become-the-event.template: +{v}% chance for seeds to grow instantly
become-the-event.description: Each seed you plant has a 1-10% chance to grow fully at once.

not-my-problem.name: Not My Problem
not-my-problem.template: +{v}% chance to skip the Hespori fight
not-my-problem.description: Planting a Hespori seed has a 2.5-17.5% chance to skip the fight and leave its rewards ready to collect.

check-the-other-side.name: Check the Other Side
check-the-other-side.template: +{v}% chance for an extra tree health check
check-the-other-side.description: A fully grown tree or fruit tree has a 3-25% chance to need its health checked an additional time.

lost-treasure.name: Lost Treasure
lost-treasure.template: +{v}% chance to fish up a clue casket
lost-treasure.description: Each catch has a 0.05-0.5% chance to fish up a clue casket. Better fishing outfits find higher tiers.

rare-catch.name: Rare Catch
rare-catch.template: +{v}% chance to catch the next fish up
rare-catch.description: Each catch has a 2-15% chance to land the next tier of fish instead.

trimmed-it.name: Trimmed It
trimmed-it.description: Each log you chop has a 3-25% chance not to deplete the tree.

magpie-nest.name: Magpie Nest
magpie-nest.template: +{v}% chance to bank gems while chopping
magpie-nest.description: Each log you chop has a 3-25% chance to send a gem to your bank.

concentrated-deposit.name: Concentrated Deposit
concentrated-deposit.description: Each successful swing has a 10% chance to mine 1-6 extra ores. The extra ores give half experience.

thats-not-coal.name: That's Not Coal
thats-not-coal.template: +{v}% chance to find gold or silver ore
thats-not-coal.description: Each ore you mine has a 4-30% chance to come with a gold or silver ore.

clean-sweep.name: Clean Sweep
clean-sweep.template: +{v}% chance to clean herbs into potions
clean-sweep.description: Each herb you clean has a 1-10% chance to become a finished potion instead.

finishing-touch.name: Finishing Touch
finishing-touch.description: Each unfinished potion you make has a 1-10% chance to come out as a finished potion.

key-ingredient.name: Key Ingredient
key-ingredient.template: +{v}% chance to find a crystal key
key-ingredient.description: Each potion you mix has a 0.1-1% chance to also give a crystal key.

excess-shaft.name: Excess Shaft
excess-shaft.template: +{v}% chance to also get forge dust
excess-shaft.description: Each batch of ammunition you fletch has a 2-15% chance to also give forge dust from the excess shafts. The ammunition is kept.

flexible-parts.name: Flexible Parts
flexible-parts.template: +{v}% chance to also get melt materials from fletched items
flexible-parts.description: Each item you fletch has a 2-15% chance to also give half the materials you would get from melting it down (odd cores and embers round down half the time). The fletched item is kept.

pie-munition.name: Pie-munition
pie-munition.description: Each fletching action has an additional 0.5-3% chance to find an Imcando geode.

seismic-strike.name: Seismic Strike
seismic-strike.template: +{v}% chance a rock does not deplete
seismic-strike.description: Each ore you mine has a 5-50% chance to leave the rock standing. Worn tools and outfits add together, up to 100%.

geologists-eye.name: Geologist's Eye
geologists-eye.template: +{v}% chance to bank an uncut gem while mining
geologists-eye.description: Each ore you mine has a 3-25% chance to send an uncut gem straight to your bank.

stonebreaker.name: Stonebreaker
stonebreaker.description: Your chance to find a clue geode while mining is 5-50% higher.

steady-pick.name: Steady Pick
steady-pick.template: +{v}% chance for each swing to succeed
steady-pick.description: Each swing of your pickaxe is 9-60% more likely to mine an ore.

molten-vein.name: Molten Vein
molten-vein.template: +{v}% chance mined ore comes out as its bar
molten-vein.description: Each ore you mine has a 4-10% chance to come out already smelted into its bar, with the Smithing experience for smelting it.

timber.name: Timber!
timber.description: Each log you chop has a 10% chance to come with 1-6 extra logs. The extra logs give half experience.

squirrels-stash.name: Squirrel's Stash
squirrels-stash.template: +{v}% chance to bank a tree seed
squirrels-stash.description: Each log you chop has a 0.5-4% chance to send a seed of that tree straight to your bank.

lumberjacks-luck.name: Lumberjack's Luck
lumberjacks-luck.description: Your chance to find a clue nest while woodcutting is 5-50% higher.

kindling.name: Kindling
kindling.template: +{v}% chance chopped logs burn at once for Firemaking experience
kindling.description: Each log you chop has a 2-15% chance to burn at once, giving the Firemaking experience for burning it instead of the log.

woodsmans-rhythm.name: Woodsman's Rhythm
woodsmans-rhythm.description: Each swing of your axe is 9-60% more likely to chop a log.

double-hook.name: Double Hook
double-hook.description: Each fish you catch has a 10% chance to come with 1-6 extra fish. The extra fish give half experience.

bottom-feeder.name: Bottom Feeder
bottom-feeder.template: +{v}% chance to bank a Herblore secondary
bottom-feeder.description: Each fish you catch has a 1-10% chance to send a common Herblore secondary straight to your bank.

message-in-a-bottle.name: Message in a Bottle
message-in-a-bottle.description: Your chance to find a clue bottle while fishing is 5-50% higher.

silver-tongue.name: Silver Tongue
silver-tongue.description: Every thieving success roll is 9-60% more likely to succeed.

sure-swipe.name: Sure Swipe
sure-swipe.template: +{v}% chance a failed stall steal succeeds
sure-swipe.description: When a steal from a stall would fail, it succeeds instead 1-18% of the time. Shares add up across worn pieces up to 100%, though gem stalls can still give nothing.

light-step.name: Light Step
light-step.template: +{v}% chance to shrug off a failed pickpocket's stun
light-step.description: When a pickpocket attempt fails, you have a 10-50% chance to slip away unnoticed and keep pickpocketing.

fences-cut.name: Fence's Cut
fences-cut.description: Coins you steal are increased by 2.5-15%.

gem-fence.name: Gem Fence
gem-fence.description: Upgrade gems you steal are increased by 2.5-15%.

plentiful-pelts.name: Plentiful Pelts
plentiful-pelts.description: Each creature you catch has a 5-30% chance to give double loot.

quick-release.name: Quick Release
quick-release.description: Checking a trap takes 10-50% less time.

snare-master.name: Snare Master
snare-master.description: Laying a trap again after checking it takes 10-50% less time.

patient-predator.name: Patient Predator
patient-predator.description: A laid trap catches its creature 5-30% sooner.

green-thumb.name: Green Thumb
green-thumb.template: +{v}% chance to keep the seed when planting
green-thumb.description: Each time you plant, you have a 10-60% chance to keep the seeds.

fertile-soil.name: Fertile Soil
fertile-soil.description: Crops you plant grow 30-200% faster (for example 100% = twice as fast).

seed-saver.name: Seed Saver
seed-saver.template: +{v}% chance to get a seed back on harvest
seed-saver.description: Each harvest has a 1-10% chance to give you back a seed of the crop.

overgrown.name: Overgrown
overgrown.description: Each harvest gives 10-60% more produce. The extra produce gives no experience.

anvil-echo.name: Anvil Echo
anvil-echo.template: +{v}% chance a multi-bar item uses one bar fewer
anvil-echo.description: Smithing an item that needs two or more bars has a 10-60% chance to use one bar fewer.

light-flux.name: Light Flux
light-flux.template: +{v}% chance to save the coal dust and luminite flux in a recipe
light-flux.description: Smithing a recipe that uses coal dust or luminite flux has a 5-35% chance to use none of it.

goldsmiths-pride.name: Goldsmith's Pride
goldsmiths-pride.description: Smelting gold bars gives 50-500% more Smithing experience.

masters-mark.name: Master's Mark
masters-mark.template: Smithed gear rolls {v} item levels higher
masters-mark.description: Armour and weapons you smith roll their affixes as if they were 2-5 item levels higher.

quick-notch.name: Quick Notch
quick-notch.template: +{v}% more ammunition per set, with the experience for the extra
quick-notch.description: Fletching ammunition makes 10-60% more per set, and the extra ammunition gives its experience too.

feather-light.name: Feather Light
feather-light.template: +{v}% chance not to use ammo tips
feather-light.description: Fletching something that needs ammo tips has a 10-50% chance to use none.

taut-string.name: Taut String
taut-string.description: Stringing a bow has a 5-30% chance to keep the bow string.

shaft-splitter.name: Shaft Splitter
shaft-splitter.template: +{v}% more arrow shafts and headless arrows
shaft-splitter.description: Making arrow shafts or headless arrows gives 10-100% more, as do the headless arrows the Fletch relic gives you from logs.

fletchers-mark.name: Fletcher's Mark
fletchers-mark.template: Fletched bows, crossbows, blowpipes and ballistas roll {v} item levels higher
fletchers-mark.description: Bows, crossbows, blowpipes and ballistas you fletch roll their affixes as if they were 2-5 item levels higher.

extra-dose.name: Extra Dose
extra-dose.template: +{v}% chance a potion comes out four-dose
extra-dose.description: Each potion you mix has a 5-30% chance to come out with four doses.

steady-pestle.name: Steady Pestle
steady-pestle.template: +{v}% chance to keep the secondary ingredient
steady-pestle.description: Each potion you mix has a 5-30% chance to keep its secondary ingredient.

handful.name: Handful
handful.description: Each time you clean herbs, you clean 1-6 more at once.

essence-weaver.name: Essence Weaver
essence-weaver.template: +{v}% chance an essence is not consumed
essence-weaver.description: Each essence you bind into runes at an altar has a 3-20% chance not to be used up.

altar-wisdom.name: Altar Wisdom
altar-wisdom.description: Crafting runes at an altar gives 6-50% more Runecrafting experience.

runeforged-mark.name: Runeforged Mark
runeforged-mark.template: Warded items roll {v} item levels higher
runeforged-mark.description: Items you make at the warding obelisk roll their affixes as if they were 2-5 item levels higher.

devout-burial.name: Devout Burial
devout-burial.description: Burying bones gives 25-175% more Prayer experience.

altars-favour.name: Altar's Favour
altars-favour.template: +{v}% experience from offering bones at altars
altars-favour.description: Offering bones at an altar gives 9-60% more Prayer experience.

ashen-offering.name: Ashen Offering
ashen-offering.description: Scattering ashes gives 25-175% more Prayer experience.

crushers-mercy.name: Crusher's Mercy
crushers-mercy.template: +{v}% chance the bonecrusher keeps its charge
crushers-mercy.description: Each bone your bonecrusher crushes has a 10-100% chance not to use a charge.

pyre-wisdom.name: Pyre Wisdom
pyre-wisdom.description: Burning logs gives 3-25% more Firemaking experience.

everburning.name: Everburning
everburning.template: +{v}% chance a log is not consumed
everburning.description: Each log you burn has a 3-20% chance not to be used up.

forge-salvage.name: Forge Salvage
forge-salvage.template: +{v}% chance to also get a made item's forge materials
forge-salvage.description: Each item you make has a 2-15% chance to also give half the forge materials you would get from melting it down (odd cores and embers round down half the time), while you keep the item. Needs the melt unlock.

tireless-hands.name: Tireless Hands
tireless-hands.description: Mining, woodcutting and fishing keep repeating 25-500 more times before you stop, so you can stay away from the keyboard for longer.

swift-hands.name: Swift Hands
swift-hands.template: +{v}% chance to gather a tick sooner
swift-hands.description: Each gather cycle has a 10-60% chance to finish one tick sooner. Worn tools and outfits feed the same roll.

bountiful-harvest.name: Bountiful Harvest
bountiful-harvest.description: Each gather has a 6-50% chance to yield double resources. Stacks with tool doubling effects. Doubled resources give half experience.

wanderers-wisdom.name: Wanderer's Wisdom
wanderers-wisdom.description: 6-60% more experience from gathering skills. Multiplies with skilling outfit bonuses.

deft-hands.name: Deft Hands
deft-hands.template: +{v}% chance to craft a tick sooner
deft-hands.description: Each production cycle has a 6-36% chance to finish one tick sooner. Pairs with instant-production effects.

masterstroke.name: Masterstroke
masterstroke.description: Each production action has a 1.5-12.5% chance to yield double output.

frugal.name: Frugal
frugal.description: Each production action has a 0.6-5% chance to keep its materials.

artisans-wisdom.name: Artisan's Wisdom
artisans-wisdom.description: 2-20% more experience from production skills. Multiplies with skilling outfit bonuses.

wild-affinity.name: Wild Affinity
wild-affinity.description: 6-60% better odds at skilling pets. Multiplies with other pet-rate bonuses.

slaughter-chance.name: Slaughter Chance
slaughter-chance.description: Adds 5-25% to the eternal bracelet of slaughter's 25% proc chance. Only functions on the eternal bracelet of slaughter. Worn bonus total caps at 75%.

expeditious-chance.name: Expeditious Chance
expeditious-chance.description: Adds 5-25% to the eternal expeditious bracelet's 25% proc chance. Only functions on the eternal expeditious bracelet. Worn bonus total caps at 75%.

sparing.name: Sparing
sparing.description: 8-33% chance each bite is free - the food is not consumed.

stalwart.name: Stalwart
stalwart.description: Take 0.5-7.5% less damage from every hit, never below 1. All worn reduction caps at 30%.

legion-echo.name: Legion Echo
legion-echo.description: Each raised greater thrall variant brings +1 additional thrall. Needs an active thrall spell; extras fade with their variant.

bloodworm-nest.name: Bloodworm Nest
bloodworm-nest.description: Your swarm holds +1-2 additional bloodworm. Stacks with the Bloodworm talent; needs at least one bloodworm from any source to take effect.

commanding.name: Commanding
commanding.description: 5-16% more damage from all your summons. Guardian, thralls, imps and bloodworms all hit harder.

undying.name: Undying
undying.description: 1-5% chance to negate a hit that would kill you. No cooldown.

vampiric.name: Vampiric
vampiric.description: Heal 1-6% of damage you deal with attacks and specials. Damage-over-time ticks do not trigger it.

zealot.name: Zealot
zealot.description: Deal 1-3% more damage for each active prayer. All worn bonus caps at 16% per prayer. Total bonus caps at 50%.
